title: Precise Shield: Explaining and Aligning VLLM Safety via Neuron-Level Guidance

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating safety alignment disparities by measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of harmful multilingual and multimodal requests across 10 different languages, specifically comparing model robustness and vulnerability between high-resource languages (HRLs) and non-high-resource languages (NHRLs).
